topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: Rain's been sluicing down since morning, turning the streets into a maze of reflections and shadows. Came in today, found a message from a client. His old lady, it seems, has been spinning a story – a novel, no less – about the both of them. Pages and pages, all the highs and lows, all the secrets tucked away in the corners of their life. Bet she thought she was the only one who knew 'em. Told him to bring the book in, said I'd take a look. Maybe there's more to this story than just a pen and a heart. Maybe there's truths tangled up in the words, things that explain why the shadows grow so long between a man and a woman.
